about.heading: About
about.bio: Hey, I'm Ayushman — a young builder, creative thinker, and curious mind exploring the intersection of technology, business, and design. I turn ideas into projects, experiment with new tools, and learn by building things in the real world. This is where I document the process — the experiments, the challenges, and everything I'm working towards.

projects.title: CartGrid
projects.short: Bringing neighbourhood shops online through a simpler, QR-powered ordering experience
projects.detail:
CartGrid is a local-commerce project exploring how neighbourhood shops can make their products accessible online. The concept focuses on QR-based discovery, simpler ordering, and a more convenient experience for both shopkeepers and customers.

The goal is to make local shopping more accessible through practical digital tools. The project is being developed and refined through experimentation, product design, and real-world problem-solving.

projects.title: Wannadateme
projects.short: A playful app experiment exploring fun and unexpected digital interactions.
projects.detail:
Prank App is a creative experiment focused on making digital interactions more playful and entertaining. The project explores how simple app experiences can surprise users and turn ordinary moments into something fun.

This project reflects my interest in experimenting with app ideas, user experiences, and creative product development.
